goal: Implement protocol-first DeepSeek diagnostics and safe rollback for Issue #10

summary.title: 实现协议优先的 DeepSeek 诊断与安全回滚
summary.what: 将 DeepSeek 推理协议诊断收窄为显式 effective thinkingFormat=deepseek；保留基于模型 id/name 的 DS cache 适配器、通用 OpenAI 兼容缓存与路由诊断；新增确认门控、隐私安全、原子且权限保持的 fix receipt 与 rollback；补充 native completion、帮助、交互菜单和非交互指引；加入 JSONC、竞态、跨进程事务、错误检测和协议矩阵回归；同步中英文 README、frontend specs 与任务验证记录；将包版本更新至 2.8.7。
summary.why: 解决 Issue #10，同时避免从模型名称、provider、URL 或 supportsReasoningEffort 猜测 reasoning wire protocol，并为已确认的配置修复提供不覆盖用户后续修改的回滚路径。
summary.user_goal: Implement protocol-first DeepSeek diagnostics and safe rollback for Issue #10

decisions.point: DeepSeek reasoning wire protocol 的判定信号
decisions.chose: 仅接受 openai-completions DeepSeek-like 模型的 effective compat 中显式 thinkingFormat=deepseek。
decisions.rationale: 模型家族身份和 supportsReasoningEffort 不足以证明服务端协议；缺少显式格式时必须保留通用兼容诊断。
rejected: 根据模型 id/name、provider id、endpoint URL 或 supportsReasoningEffort 自动推断 thinkingFormat=deepseek。

decisions.point: 配置修复和回滚的安全边界
decisions.chose: fix 与 rollback 都必须经过 UI 确认，使用 comment-preserving JSONC 编辑、唯一备份、临时文件和原子 rename，并以 receipt/hash/字段值进行 CAS 防护。
decisions.rationale: 避免响应 hook 静默修改配置，也避免旧备份覆盖用户在修复后产生的无关修改。
rejected: 从 response hook 自动写入或自动回滚 models.json。

decisions.rationale: npm 上的 2.8.6 已存在且对应旧 gitHead，npm 版本不可覆盖。

rejected.alternative: 把 thinkingFormat=deepseek 作为普通 /cache-optimizer fix 的自动建议
rejected.reason: 这会在没有协议证据时改变 provider wire behavior。

rejected.alternative: rollback 时无条件恢复旧 models.json 备份
rejected.reason: 会覆盖用户后续对 credentials、注释、无关字段或其他配置的修改。

review_notes: npm run check 通过：typecheck、88 个永久测试、git diff --check、npm pack --dry-run。
PI_CACHE_OPTIMIZER_TOOL_ORDER=0/1 全量测试均为 88/88；Issue #10 verifier 与 Trellis task validation 均通过。
receipt 仅允许事务、模型身份、placement、标量 before/after、hash、basename backup 和时间/状态字段；未持久化 token、prompt、payload、headers、response body 或 raw error。
2.8.6 已存在于 npm，本次发布目标为 2.8.7；未执行 merge、release 以外的额外交付操作。

architectural_claims: DeepSeek family detection remains independent from reasoning wire protocol detection.
Transaction receipts and rollback CAS are process-safe and preserve unrelated user configuration.
behavioral_changes: Explicit DeepSeek protocol diagnostics require explicit effective thinkingFormat=deepseek.
The rollback command is available through direct execution, completion, help, menu, and non-interactive guidance.
Reasoning rejection evidence remains model-scoped and process-local without automatic configuration mutation.

api_changes.signature: after_provider_response and message_end narrow reasoning rejection diagnostics
confirmed models.json fix/rollback transaction and receipt contract

data_model_changes.name: versioned privacy-safe rollback receipt
data_model_changes.migration_notes: Existing configuration and stats formats remain usable; receipts are created only by successful interactive fixes.

security_implications: Receipt allowlisting excludes credentials, prompts, payloads, headers, response bodies, and raw errors.
Hash, file-identity, access-mode, receipt-snapshot, and atomic-rename checks refuse unsafe rollback races instead of overwriting user changes.
migration_notes: Users upgrading to 2.8.7 should run /reload or restart Pi after a fix or rollback.
The npm 2.8.6 release is immutable; 2.8.7 is the new package version.
